status: Design draft: definitions and test paths verified at pinned commit; case-level correctness, test relevance, runtime difficulty, and runtime duration not yet empirically validated.
ground_truth_handling: Labels are evaluator-only and must not be passed to the agent.
scoring: Use implementation_localization_correct as primary task-quality gate; report strict test-file match separately; focused pytest is not evidence of bug fix.
memory_note: Do not assume short/medium/long from task names: profile tokens, number of LLM/tool steps, critical-path time, and KV occupancy after running each task.
